attBesluta.text: Just received this sturdy little table and it's perfect as a side table outside on the patio. Was very impressed with accompanying instructions (very clear and in good English) and with the ease that it went together (ALL the screw holes lined up!) In fact I'm so happy with it, I've just ordered 2 x more!
We bought one, and we like it, so we bought another one to match the first one and they look very good!!

Ich habe ein Tischchen für meinen Balkon gesucht, auf das ich einen schweren Pflanzenkübel stellen kann, das also stabil genug und wetterfest ist und dazu noch gut aussieht. Mit dem VEVOR Beistelltisch bin ich höchst zufrieden. Er sieht nicht nur sehr gut aus (gar nicht so „künstlich“, obwohl aus Kunststoff gefertigt). Er ist auch äußerst stabil und wetterfest. Die untere Platte bietet zudem noch eine zusätzliche Abstellmöglichkeit. Auch war er kinderleicht aufzubauen: Habe das zusammen mit meinem dreijährigen Enkelsohn erledigt.;) Das Preis-Leistungsverhältbis finde ich aus diesen Gründen absolut okay!
It was delivered quickly and so easy to put together.
These are very excellent, sturdy, and durable outdoor side tables. I highly recommend them.
Easy to put together and really great quality hard to believe for the price. Stop thinking about it and buy it you won’t regret it.
It has a high load capacity, supports heavy weights without shaking. Very reliable and safe for daily use.

I have used these side tables for lmost 4 months of medium use. They are very sturdy and all in all I love them. The only issue I have it that the description states that the top holds 360 pounds. My grandchildren sit on these occasionally and I have already noticed a dip in the top of the table. All of my grnadchildren are under 10 years old and the heaviest one weights 90 pounds. I don't feel that they should have that slight dip from the little ones weight, since they are less than 1/3 of the weight the company claims the table tops can hold. Even with that little issue, I do love these tables and plan to buy more. They are much sturdier for around my pool than anything else I have found. PLUS - zero maintenance.

I recently bought this Screen Door protector because our 45 pound puppy kept scratching at the screen in our camper. I got it so fast I was still able to use it while camping. It took no time at all to put it together and to place it in the existing tracks. I like it so much, I will buy a second one for the other door! Thanks Vevor for solving the "how do we save the screen door from the large puppy problem!"
We bought this for our trailer to avoid our chihuahuas from scratching the screen. It fit in perfectly and it looks great. I highly recommend it.
I bought for our 2026 Coachman Freedom Express Ultralight 259FKDS. It fits perfectly and was easy to install with only the supplied Allen wrench needed.

Better than a Lippert brand. Sturdier and less cost. The Lippert brand falls out easy. The Vevor ones are made very well. I have both sizes. The only problem is if they ship your items by GoFoo(Go Fool) or Yun Express, chances are that you are not going to get it. Friggin Joke. Could be the work force America is shot or they are just idiots.

I used this to replace a piece of plexiglass I was using on my screen door but the plexiglass would get smudged up from the dogs noses and scratched. This looks much better and allows for full air flow again.
Have never had a problem with anything I have gotten from Vevor. R V screen doors protector went on and fit perfectly. Finish is great. Would recommend.
Works well. fit was better than the lippert brand. Much cheaper too
This snap‑on RV screen door has impressed me with its solid construction and ease of use. It meets European quality expectations and feels like a product designed with real attention to detail.
Great product fit right on. Looks like it was meant to be there save the screen no dogs could scratch through it. Good price point.
Looks sturdy. Prevents my dog to pop her head through the screen of the camper door. We had a hard time with the install due to a bent corner.

We had this protector on a previous travel trailer and left it on when we traded. I ordered this item to intall on the new camper, and Lippert has added a screen door closer on some doors. I did not account for this, and this product no longer fits all Lippert doors. As far as the quality of this product, its fine once you get it installed, but does seem flimsy until it has the structure of your door.
This was recalled. So it wouldn't be good for use with children. However I kept mine I use it for my dogs and have had no issues. Although my Morkie can slip under it.

Seams like a nice screen protector but wasn't clear on putting it together and the middle seams a bit weak when the dogs push on it but has held up so far so that's a good sign to me. Fits well for my door size.
